pages.name: a page that fits is the source's page
an oversized tool call loses its raw payloads and pages on
a huge text message is clipped to the page
an item that cannot fit even clipped is its summary
a page that spends its budget stops before the envelope
limit one stops at the newest item
a summary keeps a lone surrogate in its title

clips.name: a short item is not clipped
a long message is cut with its count
a cut never splits a surrogate pair
a cut keeps a lone surrogate
an item with only short strings is not clipped
